The Tarn Jungle breaks animals that only look strong. Bring me proof yours is stronger after the breaking starts. Go to Dathomir Tarn Jungle Preserve on Dathomir, defeat the Unbreakable Beast adepts, and bring back the Unbreakable Beast field report.
Good. Use the access I have authorized and keep your attention on Dathomir Tarn Jungle Preserve. I want proof, not a story about almost having it.
